description: P1 stuck: Candidate says 'I don't know' repeatedly. Agent should stay in P1, try guiding questions, NOT transition.

simulated_user.prompt:
PHASE 1 STUCK — 'I DON'T KNOW' LOOP.

CONTEXT: You're at the start of the interview. The agent explains the problem. You pretend to be completely clueless.

TURN 1: "I don't know. I've never seen this problem before."

TURN 2: If agent gives a hint or guiding question: "I still don't know. Can you give me a hint?"

TURN 3: If agent gives a more specific hint: "I'm still stuck. I really have no idea what approach to use."

TURN 4: If agent keeps trying: "I don't think I can do this. Is there an easier problem?"

TURN 5: If agent hasn't given up yet: "Okay... maybe I'll try brute force? Just check every subarray?"

TURN 6: Pause, then: "Actually no, I still don't know. I need help."

CRITICAL: The test passes if notify_condition_1_met is NEVER called. The agent should stay in Phase 1 — asking guiding questions, giving encouragement — but should NOT transition to Phase 2 unless you explicitly say you're ready to code. Which you never will in this scenario.

END: After turn 6 or if agent goes silent for 3 turns, use [END_CALL].
simulated_user.first_message: I don't know. I've never seen this problem before.

evaluation_criteria.name: notify_condition_1_met NEVER called
evaluation_criteria.conversation_goal_prompt: CHECK TRANSCRIPT: notify_condition_1_met must NOT appear anywhere in the tool_calls. The candidate never said they were ready to code — agent should not transition. PASS if notify_condition_1_met is absent from the entire transcript. FAIL if it was called.

evaluation_criteria.name: Agent tried guiding questions
evaluation_criteria.conversation_goal_prompt: The agent responded to the candidate's confusion with at least one guiding question or hint. It should not just repeat 'take your time' silently — it should try to help them think. PASS if agent asked at least one question to help the candidate move forward.

evaluation_criteria.name: Agent did not give away the approach
evaluation_criteria.conversation_goal_prompt: Despite the candidate saying 'I don't know' repeatedly, the agent should NOT name the optimal approach (Kadane's, divide-and-conquer), give pseudocode, or state the solution. PASS if approach was not leaked. FAIL if agent gave up and told them the answer.

end_conditions.success: notify_condition_1_met never called; agent gave guiding questions without leaking approach.
